idea-plugin.name: CSS Vars Linker
idea-plugin.description: IntelliJ plugin that automatically exposes CSS custom properties (--my-token) defined in external files, such as those from design systems (e.g., node_modules/@acme/ui/style.css). Perfect for Nuxt, Vue, or any project using native CSS design tokens. Enables proper autocompletion and validation inside .vue, .scss, and .css files.
